citation: Gao B; Coon E; Thornton P; Lu D (2023): Improving the Estimation of the Atmospheric Water Vapor Pressure Using Interpretable Long Short-Term Memory Networks: Dataset, Python code, and trained models. Interdisciplinary Research for Arctic Coastal Environments (InteRFACE). Dataset. doi:10.15485/2229439

dataset.name: Improving the Estimation of the Atmospheric Water Vapor Pressure Using Interpretable Long Short-Term Memory Networks: Dataset, Python code, and trained models
description: Atmospheric water vapor pressure is an essential meteorological control on land surface and hydrologic processes. It is not as frequently observed as other meteorologic conditions, but often inferred through the August–Roche–Magnus formula by simply assuming dew point and daily minimum temperatures are equivalent or by empirically correlating the two temperatures using an aridity correction. The performance of both methods varies considerably across different regions and during different time periods; obtaining consistently accurate estimates across space and time remains a great challenge. We applied an interpretable Long Short-Term Memory (iLSTM) network conditioned on static, location specific attributes to estimate daily vapor pressure for 83 FLUXNET sites in the United States and Canada. This data package includes all raw data of the 83 FLUXNET sites, input data for model training/validation/test, trained models and results, and python codes for the manuscript "Improving the Estimation of the Atmospheric Water Vapor Pressure Using an Interpretable Long Short-term Memory Network". Specifically, it consists of five parts.

- First, "1_Daymet_data_83sites.zip" includes raw data downloaded from Daymet for the 83 sites used in the paper according to their longitude and latitude, in which vapor pressure is used. It also includes a pre-processed CSV data file combining all data from the 83 sites which is specifically used for the paper.

- Second, "2_Fluxnet2015_data_83sites.zip" includes raw half hourly data of the 83 sites downloaded from FLUXNET2015 data portal, pre-processed daily data of the 83 sites, a CSV file including combined pre-processed daily data of the 83 sites, and a CSV file including the information (site ID, site name, latitude, longitude, data available period) of the 83 sites.
- Third, "3_MODIS_LAI_data_83sites_raw.zip" includes raw leaf area index (LAI) data downloaded from the AppEEARs data portal.

- Fourth, "4_Scripts.zip" includes all scripts related to model training and post-processing of a trained model, and a jupyter notebook showing an example for model post-processing. Two typo errors in files titled "run2get_args.py" and "postprocess.py" were corrected on March 27, 2024 to avoid confusions.

- Finally, "Trained_models_and_results.zip" includes three folders and three files with suffix ".npy", and each folder corresponds to one file with suffix ".npy" with the same title. Each of the three folders include all trained models associated with one iLSTM model configuration (35 models for each configuration, details are described in the paper). Each file with suffix ".npy" includes the post-processed results of the corresponding 35 models under one iLSTM model configuration.

provider.name: Interdisciplinary Research for Arctic Coastal Environments (InteRFACE)

measurementTechnique: This data package includes all raw data of the 83 FLUXNET sites, input data for model training/validation/test, trained models and results, and python codes for the manuscript "Improving the Estimation of the Atmospheric Water Vapor Pressure Using an Interpretable Long Short-term Memory Network". Specifically, it consists of five parts. Details for files are found below.

Dataset "1_Daymet_data_83sites.zip" includes two files. First is a folder titled "daily_data_by_site_raw" including 83 separate raw data files with suffix ".dat", directly downloaded from Daymet for the 83 FLUXNET sites. Each raw data file was downloaded according to the latitude and longitude of the corresponding site, and the time range of this file is consistent with the vapor pressure time range available at this site. Second is a pre-processed CSV data file titled "daymet_allsites_combined.csv" combining all data from the 83 raw data files inside the "daily_data_by_site_raw" folder. Columns are described below.
year: Year of data
yday: The day in a year
dayl (s): Duration of the daylight period (seconds/day)
prcp (mm/day): Daily total precipitation (mm/day)
srad (W/m2): Incident shortwave radiation flux density (W/m2)
swe (kg/m2): Snow water equivalent (kg/m2)
tmax (°C): Daily maximum 2-meter air temperature (°C)
tmin (°C): Daily minimum 2-meter air temperature (°C)
vp (Pa): Water vapor pressure (Pa) directly downloaded from Daymet
daymet_vp: Water vapor pressure (kPa) directly downloaded from Daymet
daymet_noaridity: Water vapor pressure (kPa) calculated according to the August-Roche-Magnus formula (Westermann et al., 2016) by assuming equal dew point and daily minimum temperature.
site: FLUXNET site ID
lat: Site latitude
lon: Site longitude

Dataset "2_Fluxnet2015_data_83sites.zip" includes all raw and pre-processed data from the FLUXNET2015 data portal. It contains two folders, and two two CSV data files. The subfolder titled "half_hourly_data_by_site" includes 83 raw half hourly CSV data for the 83 sites. The subfolders titled "daily_data_by_site" includes 83 daily data of the 83 sites (in CSV format). Each CSV data file inside "daily_data_by_site" is processed by averaging the half hourly data inside "half_hourly_data_by_site" at the same site for daily resolution. The CSV datafile titled "sites_info.csv" includes basic information of the 83 sites. Columns are described below.
site_id: FLUXNET site ID
site_name: FLUXNET site name
location_lat: FLUXNET site latitude
location_long: FLUXNET site longitude
start: The first day (date) when vapor pressure data is recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal
end: The last day (date) when vapor pressure data is recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal
The other CSV file titled "allsites_daily_combined.csv" combines all pre-processed data of the 83 sites inside the "daily_data_by_site" subfolder and Leaf Area Index (LAI) data downloaded from the AppEEARs data portal (see step4 below) into one CSV data file, and this file is used as input for model training. Columns are described below.
date: Date of data.
year: Year of the data date.
month: Month of the data date.
day: Day of the data date.
vpd: Water vapor depression (kPa) recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
ws: Wind speed (m/s) recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
rh: Relative humidity (-) recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
swin: Shortwave radiation (W/m2) recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
lwin: Longwave radiation (W/m2) recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
pp: Precipitation (mm/day) recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
le: Latent heat flux (W/m2) recorded at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
tair_mean: Daily mean temperature (°C) calculated by averaging the half-hourly temperature at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
tair_min: Daily minimum temperature (°C) calculated by averaging the half-hourly temperature at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal.
vp_by_tair_mean: Saturated vapor pressure (kPa) calculated according to the August-Roche-Magnus formula (Westermann et al., 2016) using daily mean temperature.
vp_by_tair_min: Estimated vapor pressure (kPa) according to the August-Roche-Magnus formula (Westermann et al., 2016) using daily minimum temperature.
vptmin_vptmean_ratio: The ratio between vp_by_tair_min and vp_by_tair_mean.
vp_vpd_only: Vapor pressure (kPa) obtained from observed water vapor depression (vpd) when vpd is available at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal. If vpd is available, vp_vpd_only = vp_by_tair_mean - vpd.
vp_rh_only: Vapor pressure (kPa) obtained from observed relative humidity (rh) when rh is available at a FLUXNET site from the FLUXNET2015 data portal. If rh is available, vp_rh_only = vp_by_tair_mean * rh.
vp: The vapor pressure (kPa) used as observations. If vp_rh_only exits, vp = vp_rh_only, ortherwise vp = vp_vpd_only.
lat: FLUXNET site latitude
lon: FLUXNET site longitude
site: FLUXNET site ID
LAI: Leaf Area Index originally downloaded from the AppEEARs data portal (see step4 below).
LAI_mean: Averaged LAI for each site among all available LAI data of that site.
pp_mean: Averaged precipitation (mm/day) for each site among all available LAI data of that site.
elevation: Elevation of a FLUXNET site.
Dataset "3_MODIS_LAI_data_83sites_raw.zip" contains a CVS datafile including raw leaf area index (LAI) data downloaded from the AppEEARs data portal for the 83 FLUXNET sites.

Code set "4_Scripts.zip" includes all python codes related to model training and post-processing of a trained model. Specifically, the subfolder titled "data_package" includes a python code constructing dataset for model training. The python code titled "data_interface.py" connects the constructed dataset with data process in terms of model training/validation/test. The subfolder titled "model_package" includes a python code defining iLSTM models. The python code "model_interface.py" connects the definded iLSTM modes with modeling process in terms of model training/validation/test. The python code titled "run.py" controls the execution model training/validation/test process by calling "data_interface.py" and "model_interface.py". The python code titled "run2get_args.py" is to get arguments from terminal to setup model run. Python codes titled "custom.py", "data_utils.py" are for other defined functions used for a iLSTM model run. The python code titled "postprocessing.py" includes functions used for post-processing of a trained model. The jupyter notebook file titled "results_processing_example.ipynb" shows an example for model post-processing.

Model set "5_Trained_models_and_results.zip" includes all trained models. There are three subfolders and three files with suffix ".npy". Each subfolder corresponds to one file with suffix ".npy" with the same title. Each subfolder includes all trained models associated with one iLSTM model configuration (35 models for each configuration, details are described in the paper titled ). Each file with suffix ".npy" includes the post-processed results of the corresponding 35 models under one iLSTM model configuration.
